description: This Java class 'TbMsgPackProcessingContext' manages the processing context for message packs in the Thingsboard server, including tracking message states, profiling, and handling success/failure scenarios.

classes.name: TbMsgPackProcessingContext
classes.description: Processing context for message packs, handling message states, profiling, and coordination in message processing.

methods.name: await
methods.description: Waits for message processing to complete or timeout.

methods.name: onProcessingStart
methods.description: Marks the start of processing for a message.

methods.name: onProcessingEnd
methods.description: Marks the end of processing for a message.

methods.name: onTimeout
methods.description: Handles timeout profiling for a message.

methods.name: getLastVisitedRuleNode
methods.description: Retrieves the last visited rule node for a message.

methods.name: printProfilerStats
methods.description: Outputs profiling statistics for rule nodes.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Clears processing state and marks context as canceled.

methods.name: isCanceled
methods.description: Checks if processing has been canceled.
